# Report server tools

The `pbi-report` server builds and edits the **report** (PBIR) of a Power BI Project: pages, visuals, formatting, themes, filters and design elements. Every report write is validated against the official Fabric schemas before it reaches disk. Call `pbi_set_project(path)` first, then `pbi_capabilities()` to learn the visual types, buckets and filters.

**50 tools** (17 read-only, 33 write).

## How to read this page

- **Read-only** tools never change the project. **Write** tools do.
- **Destructive** marks tools that delete or overwrite content, so hosts can
  ask before running them. **Idempotent** means repeating the call with the
  same arguments changes nothing further.
- Write tools that edit project files accept `dry_run=true`: the operation
  runs on a scratch copy and returns the unified diff, and nothing is
  written. Every real write is journaled and can be reverted with
  `pbi_undo`. Do not use `dry_run` with the restore tools that take a path
  into the project. See [Safety](../safety.md#dry-run).
- Types are JSON Schema types. A parameter is **required** when it has no
  default.

## Project and diagnostics

### `pbi_capabilities`

**Read-only** · idempotent

What this server can build: visual types + buckets, filters, formatting,
design elements, workflow, and a worked example. Call after set_project.

_No parameters._

### `pbi_doctor`

**Read-only** · idempotent

Diagnose the environment and the selected project (read-only,
never raises). Reports Python, mcp SDK and pbi-mcp versions; whether
the report is PBIR (editable) or legacy report.json and the model is
TMDL or legacy model.bim; declared $schema versions vs the vendored
ones; table, measure, page and visual counts; backup, undo-journal
and trash sizes; and (Windows) the installed Power BI Desktop version
and whether a Desktop instance is running. Works before
`pbi_set_project` for the environment checks. Returns {ok,
findings[{severity, check, message, fix?}], environment, project}; ok
is false only if a finding has severity 'error'.

_No parameters._

### `pbi_project_diff`

**Read-only**

Diff the current project against another .pbip (or a backup dir):
measures/pages/visuals/relationships added/removed/changed.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `other_path` | string | yes |  |

### `pbi_project_summary`

**Read-only**

A compact overview: tables, measures, relationships, pages, visuals,
and field-usage counts.

_No parameters._

### `pbi_set_project`

**Read-only** · idempotent

Point the report server at a Power BI Project (.pbip). Call this first.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes |  |

## Undo, transactions and recovery

### `pbi_begin_transaction`

**Write**

Mark a point so several writes can be reverted together with
`pbi_rollback`, or kept with `pbi_commit`. One open transaction at a time.

_No parameters._

### `pbi_commit`

**Write**

Close the open transaction, keeping every write made since
`pbi_begin_transaction`.

_No parameters._

### `pbi_list_trash`

**Read-only**

List recoverable deleted pages/visuals in .pbi/mcp-trash.

_No parameters._

### `pbi_restore_visual`

**Write**

Restore a deleted visual (path from `pbi_list_trash`) back onto its page.

Set dry_run=true to preview: the operation runs against a scratch copy and the response carries the unified diff; nothing is written.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `trash_path` | string | yes |  |
| `dry_run` | boolean | no | `false` |

### `pbi_rollback`

**Write** · destructive

Revert every write made since `pbi_begin_transaction` and close the
transaction.

_No parameters._

### `pbi_undo`

**Write** · destructive

Revert the latest `steps` journaled writes (newest first), restoring
every changed file byte-for-byte and deleting files those writes
added. Not journaled itself, so it cannot be undone.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `steps` | integer | no | `1` |

### `pbi_undo_history`

**Read-only** · idempotent

Journaled writes for the selected project, newest first: id, tool,
time and the files it added/modified/deleted. Both servers share the
history; any entry can be reverted with `pbi_undo`.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | integer | no | `20` |

## Autopilot and analysis

### `pbi_model_usage`

**Read-only**

Classify model fields as direct (bound in report), indirect (needed by
a bound measure or a relationship), or unused. The deletion fail-safe.

_No parameters._

### `pbi_profile_model`

**Read-only**

Classify the model (fact/dimension/date tables, measure roles, grouping
columns) — the analysis that drives `pbi_scaffold_report`.

_No parameters._

### `pbi_scaffold_report`

**Write**

AUTOPILOT: profile the model and build a full designed report — themed
overview page (KPI strip + trend + breakdown + table) plus per-dimension
detail pages with a nav bar. dry_run=true returns the proposal to edit
first. Omit accent to inherit the report's existing theme (won't overwrite
it). Fastest path from a raw model to an epic report.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `accent` | string | no | `null` |
| `max_detail_pages` | integer | no | `3` |
| `dry_run` | boolean | no | `false` |
| `theme` | boolean | no | `true` |

## Building pages

### `pbi_build_designed_page`

**Write**

Build a fully DESIGNED page in one call: header band, KPI strip on
rounded backplates, and a chart grid — themed and laid out.
kpis: [{"measure": "Table.M", "title": "..."}]. charts: normal visual
specs (positions auto-assigned). accent is the header/brand '#hex' —
omit it to inherit the report's existing theme color; page size is
inherited too. Pass match_page=&lt;existing page id> to copy that page's
header/KPI composition so the new page matches it closely.

Set dry_run=true to preview: the operation runs against a scratch copy and the response carries the unified diff; nothing is written.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes |  |
| `title` | string | yes |  |
| `subtitle` | string | no | `null` |
| `kpis` | array | no | `null` |
| `charts` | array | no | `null` |
| `template` | string | no | `"exec-summary"` |
| `accent` | string | no | `null` |
| `match_page` | string | no | `null` |
| `dry_run` | boolean | no | `false` |

## Filters

### `pbi_add_filter`

**Write**

Add a filter at report/page/visual scope. field='Table.Field'.
Categorical: values=[...]. Advanced: comparison in eq|gt|ge|lt|le +
comparison_value. TopN: top_n (rank by the visual's value field).
RelativeDate: last_n + relative_unit in day|week|month|year.
